title: F/CTL SLATS FAULT/LOCKED

alert.trigger: The SLATS FAULT alert triggers when there is a failure of both slats channels. The SLATS LOCKED alert triggers when the slats wing tip brakes are activated.

effectivity.note: Two FCOM units. Only HS-TXA..TXO has the FUEL MODE SEL / CTR TK PUMPS lines (see HS-TX differences).

summary: An amber caution: the slats have stopped. On takeoff, select the speed and stop the acceleration before VFE. If locked (wing tip brake on), hold the table MAX SPEED. If not locked, recycle the flaps lever once below VFE. A SLATS FAULT from both channels also gives alternate law, then direct law at gear down. If unsuccessful, apply the QRH LANDING WITH SLATS OR FLAPS JAMMED with flap lever 3 for landing.

background.text: Causes: dual slats control unit (SFCC slats channel) failure, dual hydraulic failure, a combination, a mechanical jam, or locking by wing tip brake activation.

Consequences: the control laws may change, the selected speed must be used, an early stabilized approach should be preferred, approach attitudes change, approach speeds and landing distances increase, and the go-around procedure may have to be modified.
With 2 SFCC slat channels failed, pitch is in alternate law with no protections, and roll is in direct law.
For flight with SLATS or FLAPS extended, fuel consumption is increased. Refer to QRH/OPS Fuel Penalty Factors/ECAM Alert Table.

technique.text: If a slats/flaps retraction failure occurs during takeoff, pull the SPD/MACH knob to select the speed and stop the acceleration, to avoid exceeding VFE. The overspeed warning follows the actual slats/flaps position.
The landing distance available at the departure airport and the aircraft gross weight determine the next course of action.
The AP may be used down to 500 ft AGL. It is not tuned for abnormal configurations: monitor it.

gaps.text: F/CTL SLATS FAULT/LOCKED is not in the QRH reset table.
The PDP has no slide for this failure: the turns come from the FCTM AOP-30-30 sequence and PR-AEP-F_CTL. The FCTM says "the crew" pulls the knob; it is shown for the PF, who flies.
The STATUS line on slats locked in clean configuration names other types (A318/A319, A319/A321); HS-TX aircraft are all A320-232, so only the both-channels case is shown.
The ECAM calls the alert F/CTL SLATS FAULT or F/CTL SLATS LOCKED: announce the title shown.
